traits.name: Natural Hunter
traits.text: The Wendigo has advantage on Stealth checks made while it is hunting.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The Wendigo makes one claw and one bite attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: +7 to hit (+9 when bloodied), reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) slashing damage; 13 (1d12 + 6) slashing damage when bloodied.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text:
+7 to hit (+9 when bloodied), reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage; 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage when bloodied.

If a target is bitten, it must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw.  It takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.
